en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square with a prominent multi‑story town hall building featuring a clock tower and ornate façade on the left. In front of it is a circular fountain. To the right stands a simpler multi‑story building and further right, among trees, a tall war memorial obelisk. The foreground shows the open marketplace. Printed captions in German identify the place and publisher.
